svg.title: Fairness: Test Outcomes, Not Columns
svg.desc: Left: a model trained on past decisions learns their bias. Deleting the sensitive column, such as gender, does not help, because proxies such as postcode, career gaps and clubs still carry the bias. Right: so fairness is measured instead. Compare approval and error rates per group on a held-out test set. If there is a gap between groups, rebalance or augment the training data and re-measure. If there is no gap, launch and keep monitoring in production.
svg.text: Deleting a sensitive column leaves proxies behind; measuring outcomes per group finds the bias.
The training data the model learns from
Approval and error rates on a held-out test
